title: Website Rescue — Before, After and Enquiry Flow

purpose.buyer: Owner or manager who needs to see a realistic before/after and how enquiry capture works.
purpose.problem: An outdated site damages credibility and weakens enquiry flow.
purpose.outcome: A fictional before/after on Harbour Hospitality Supplies plus a labelled discovery form that does not send automatically.
purpose.buyer_action: Walk the demo, then request discovery on the named Website Rescue landing.

pronunciation.say: corpflow A I dot com slash demo slash website-rescue

script.full_text: An outdated site damages credibility and weakens enquiry flow. Here is a typical before: Harbour Hospitality Supplies — a fictional business — with the offer buried, no clear mobile next step, and an enquiry path that goes nowhere. After Website Rescue, the same fictional business has one clear headline, a single buyer-action call to action, a mobile-ready layout, and a working enquiry form. No invented metrics. No private client names. Proof is the before and after you can walk yourself. You do not submit a live enquiry on camera. The form is labelled Request discovery — Website Rescue so the buyer knows the product. On the live Website Rescue page, Request discovery opens a labelled form. Nothing is sent automatically to email, WhatsApp, or SMS. We do not guarantee new revenue. See the demonstration at corpflowai.com/demo/website-rescue. Then request discovery at corpflowai.com/website-rescue.
disclosures: We do not guarantee new revenue.
